# Upstream workflows, disabled

`docker-publish.yml` is the upstream MetaMCP workflow that built and pushed images to ghcr.io/metatool-ai. It is kept here for reference and does not run. Hubstead's CI is in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and does not push images. A publish workflow will be added only after review. Until then there is no Hubstead image; build from source (see README.md).
